xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:AnyOtherInformationForDisclosu: CMS Info Systems Limited approved the acquisition of Securens Systems Private Limited on July 23, 2025, to be completed in multiple tranches. Pursuant thereto, CMS acquired 53.89% stake on September 16, 2025, followed by an additional 2.28% on October 1, 2025, increasing its holding to 56.17%. Subsequently, pursuant to participation in the Rights Issue on October 7, 2025, the stake increased to 75.78%. Further acquisition on October 28, 2025 increased the shareholding to 99.50%, and upon acquisition of the remaining shares on March 9, 2026, CMS Info Systems Limited completed the acquisition of 100% shareholding in Securens Systems Private Limited, making it a wholly owned subsidiary of the Company.
